scope: Primary supplementary qualifications, not new lecture coverage or pretrained runtime verification.

hamming.finding: The symmetric denominator is M−1; sym=False requests the periodic convention. Hamming has nonzero endpoints.

mfcc.finding: MFCCs can be computed from a log-power Mel spectrogram using a DCT; temporal delta features are a separate operation.

delta.finding: Delta features estimate derivatives along a feature sequence; they are not automatically present in a static MFCC vector.

conv.locator: Definition, cross-correlation operator, Shape output-length equation
conv.finding: Conv1d uses cross-correlation, channel-specific kernels and an explicit stride/padding/dilation output-length rule.

small.finding: The checked whisper-small configuration specifies 80 Mel bins.

large.finding: The checked whisper-large-v3 configuration specifies 128 Mel bins.

model.finding: Audio positions are registered sinusoids; text positions are learned parameters. The two audio Conv1d strides are 1 and 2, each followed by GELU.

audio.finding: This checked implementation uses 16 kHz, 400-point Hann windows and a 160-sample hop; log-Mel values are clamped, dynamically limited and rescaled. This is not the generic lecture Hamming pipeline.

notebook.locator: Code cells loading sample.flac, preprocessing and printing transcription
notebook.finding: The linked notebook retrieves a public FLAC and adds a labeled print statement. Its saved output is reported evidence, not reproduced inference.
